# Implementation and budget by phase (generated by scripts/make_implementation.py from the model outputs)

Funding route: a ring-fenced Beqaa window within the Lebanon Humanitarian Fund (registry F004; proposed). A host-project add-on is an optional cost saving. Costs are start-up costs from sourced unit prices (`data/processed/unit_costs.csv`); sample counts and the share of households covered are assumptions (sliders in the Pilot design section); catalogue filter prices are ex-works and exclude freight; there is no Lebanese Cr(VI) price.

| Phase | Where | Budget (central, range) | Who acts | KPIs that unlock the next step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Phase 1: pilot site (months 0-12) | Saadnayel (Zahle), first on the start-site scorer; no single cadaster is stable under random weights, so the cluster around it is the unit | $33,343 start-up ($29,288-$39,634) at full coverage of 2016 settlement households with filters; plus CHW pay $300 a month | consortium lead (primary-care operator), AUB lab, municipality; LHF window funds; MoPH approves the referral endpoint | referral completion >= 0.40, posts filled >= 0.60, transparent reporting published; baselines set in months 1-3 |
| Phase 2: wave 2 (months 6-24) | the CNRS-L soil villages Bouday and Chmistar, and Hermel | $15,168 for Bouday + Chmistar (+ $10,601 for Hermel) | same consortium; AUB lab for Cr(VI) speciation (US price proxy $40-77; no Lebanese price) | pilot KPIs met in phase 1 for two consecutive quarters; Cr(VI) result decides protective action |
| Phase 3: district clusters (years 2-4) | the Saadnayel cluster (10 cadasters) and the Baalbek cluster (5 cadasters) | $251,141 + $48,643 start-up at full coverage; filters dominate the cost and scale with the share of households covered | national NGO rung, then the municipal union as capacity reaches 0.40 | capacity >= 0.30 then 0.40 (growth capped at 0.05 a year); referral and posts thresholds held |
| Phase 4: handover (to 2030) | control of the window moves INGO -> national NGO -> union of municipalities -> MoPH | no new budget line: the window is administered at the higher rung | MoPH (standards, referral), municipal union (administration), LHF secretariat (verification) | thresholds met and published; independent spot check; the share of money held by Lebanese organisations rises |

Recurring costs (not in the start-up figures): CHW pay $300 a month per CHW (secondary source), water tests $55 per source (nitrate $25 + chromium $30, AUB), primary-care service $20.03 (K2P/UNICEF 2022). Everything unsourced stays a slider with a break-even (`docs/ASSUMPTIONS_PILOT.md`); the pilot measures the rest.
